ClearDisk 2.2.0

Storage and performance checks in one app. Open Performance in the sidebar.

  • See CPU activity, memory pressure, thermal state and running processes, with explanations of common background processes.
  • Review background items, connection information and per-app network activity. An optional speed test uses Apple's networkQuality service after confirmation.
  • Follow CPU and memory charts, keep optional local usage history, and enable an optional menu-bar monitor.
  • Review supported Chrome, Brave and Edge tabs after granting browser Automation access. Review windows, duplicate tabs and estimated extension usage.
  • Use your existing ClearDisk license for performance actions. Quitting apps, changing browser tabs, rebuilding Spotlight's index and restarting require confirmation; protected system processes cannot be quit through ClearDisk.

Monitoring is not a hardware diagnostic or a guarantee of better performance. Available readings depend on macOS permissions and hardware. History stays on your Mac. Login startup is optional. Existing disk cleanup, iCloud Doctor and Mac checks remain available.

Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon or Intel. Existing licenses remain valid.

ClearDisk 2.1.0

Two new read-only checks, built into ClearDisk.

  • Apple Intelligence storage: measure recognized model and support folders, see where they live, and understand which locations could not be read. macOS manages these assets; ClearDisk does not delete them.
  • Intel app review: find installed apps with Intel-only main executables before upgrading beyond macOS 27. Universal, Apple silicon and undetermined results stay distinct. Plug-ins and helper programs need a separate review.

Open Mac checks in the sidebar. A full disk scan is not required. Neither check changes your files.

Read Apple's Rosetta compatibility guidance, including the limited exception for certain older games.

ClearDisk 2.0.0

  • Type delete to confirm permanent removal, without retyping long filenames. Move to Trash remains available.
  • Check for Updates in the ClearDisk menu. Future releases download, verify, install and relaunch from the app when you choose.
  • Updates are signed and verified before installation. Restart waits until active cleanup or iCloud file operations finish.
  • A clearer drag-to-Applications installer with ClearDisk branding.

Your existing license continues to work. ClearDisk 1.1.1 users need one manual download to get the new updater.
